handlingUnit.description: The packaging level a standard is declared for, and that a completed task handled (ADR 0035). INNER is deliberately absent: no flow implements it in v1.
handlingUnit.title: HandlingUnit

travelComponentSeconds.description: Optional; omitted or null means not broken out. When present, must be between 0 and expectedSeconds inclusive (otherwise 422).

teamLift.description: The declared heavy-case rule of a CASE standard: a case heavier than thresholdG grams needs two operators and is scored against expectedSeconds instead of the standard's own. Declarative input; this service never looks a case weight up from a sibling context.

thresholdG.description: Weight in grams ABOVE which a case needs a team lift (a case weighing exactly thresholdG is still a one-operator lift).

expectedSeconds.description: Engineered elapsed seconds of a team lift.

teamLift.title: TeamLiftRequest

siteCode.description: The facility (facility-layout site code) a standard is scoped to (ADR 0038): 1-32 characters, no whitespace. Absent means the site-less standard that applies to every site. Declarative input: this service never looks a site up in a sibling context.
siteCode.title: SiteCode

casePick.summary: A CASE pick standard, distinct from an each pick

heavyCaseTeamLift.summary: A CASE standard with a declared heavy-case team lift

siteStandard.summary: A PICK standard scoped to one site (ADR 0038)
